About the Principal & Leadership Vision

Leading Educational Transformation in Khichripur

Under the visionary stewardship of Principal Dr. R. K. Sharma, DBRA CM SHRI School, Khichripur (School ID: 1002400) has emerged as a benchmark institution in East Delhi. With over two decades of distinguished service in the Directorate of Education, he champions technology-integrated classrooms, foundational literacy, and competitive STEM readiness.

"Our motto 'ज्ञानं प्रगति मार्गः' (Knowledge is the Path to Progress) reflects our commitment to every student. When teachers, parents, and technology work in harmony, every child discovers their limitless potential."
